title: NASA/Department of War special investigation of Apollo 17 lights image

tellings.quote: NASA released this image uh in the first trunch, there was a description about it uh next to the image and they say in the description that uh the department of war and NASA have opened an a special investigation for this particular image

plain: In 2026 NASA released an image from Apollo 17, the last crewed Moon landing, showing lights, and the note next to it said that "the department of war and NASA have opened a special investigation for this particular image." A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani says this, pointing to the first batch of NASA's released files on UAP, the government's term for UFOs, with the Department of War being the Pentagon under its new name. If true, the space agency and the military are formally looking into something seen on the Moon.
